lead.headline: U.S. imposes 50% tariffs on Canada as talks collapse at deadline
lead.dek: Carney suspended negotiations and said Canada will match the duties dollar for dollar.
body: Trade talks between the United States and Canada collapsed Friday night, minutes before a midnight deadline, and 50% tariffs on about $20 billion in Canadian goods took effect at midnight. The duties fall on hockey sticks, building materials, liquors and some clothing.

Prime Minister Mark Carney sent his negotiators back to Ottawa, saying late changes to the U.S. terms were unfair and uneconomic. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Canada declined to finalize a deal reached earlier in the week, and that Washington had offered cuts on steel, aluminum, autos and lumber. Provincial bans on American alcohol were among the sticking points.

briefs.headline: Supreme Court lets White House ballroom work continue
briefs.summary: The justices stayed an injunction against the 90,000-square-foot addition. The National Trust for Historic Preservation sued.

briefs.headline: Charter plane crash kills 8 at an Alaska radar site
briefs.summary: The plane left Anchorage and went down Thursday on approach to Cape Newenham, 450 miles west. Two pilots and six passengers died.

briefs.headline: Pentagon fires Stars and Stripes editor and a reporter
briefs.summary: Editor Erik Slavin, reporter Lara Korte and publisher Max Lederer were cited for insubordination after a CBS interview on editorial independence.

briefs.headline: Somalia child malnutrition jumps 32% as aid funding falls
briefs.summary: UNICEF said nutrition funding fell more than 80% this year and 200 facilities closed. Nearly 1.9 million children are affected.

briefs.headline: Ceuta buries 18 unidentified migrants in numbered graves
briefs.summary: More than 90 died in the late-July crossings from Morocco, the deadliest on Spain's border. Thousands remain in the enclave.

briefs.headline: World Bank projects Lebanon's economy to shrink 6.4%
briefs.summary: The contraction follows 4.2% growth last year and stems from fighting that began in March. Prices are expected to rise 17.5%.

briefs.headline: Borneo fires push haze into Malaysia and close schools
briefs.summary: Indonesia logged 154,000 hotspots by Aug. 11. Sarawak's pollution index passed 200 and six schools moved online.

briefs.headline: Four die as a car goes off the interstate in Charleston
briefs.summary: The driver lost control at the I-77/I-64 split about 10:52 p.m. Friday and tumbled into the yard below. Names have not been released.

briefs.headline: Federal directive raises the state's canvass threshold
briefs.summary: Homeland Security requires states to canvass 5% of ballots or lose 20% of grant funds. State law sets 3% of precincts, so clerks must add more.

regional.item: Radiology software firm Synthesis Health will take the Med-Tech building in Marshall's IDEA District.
Rep. Riley Moore gave Parkersburg $1M Friday toward replacing its 55-year-old services garage.

briefs.headline: Three minutes of sprinting outdid 90 of steady cycling
briefs.summary: Six 30-second sprints changed nearly a quarter of measured blood proteins; moderate cycling changed under 0.25%. Cell Reports Medicine.

briefs.headline: Queen bees offload pesticide into their eggs
briefs.summary: Workers filtered out 95% of methyl parathion on day one but 86% by day 10; queens shed the rest into their eggs. Current Biology.

briefs.headline: Pancreatic cancer patients with more teeth lived longer
briefs.summary: Among 339 people who had a pancreatectomy, those with 21 or more natural teeth had median survival of 60.7 months against 39.1.

briefs.headline: Collisions show neon and oxygen nuclei hold different shapes
briefs.summary: Neon-20's stronger elliptic flow fits a bowling-pin shape, oxygen-16's a tetrahedron. Physical Review Letters.
